== Biography ==
'''Mary Glasgow''' was born on 07 Apr 1744 and baptised at Kilmarnock, Ayrshire, on 11 Apr 1744. The parish register names her father as [[Glasgow-4167|Hugh Glasgow]] and her mother as [[Giffen-664|Margaret Giffen]].<ref name="FMP1" /> The register records both dates; Kilmarnock is inferred from the baptism and is not independently recorded.
